heading: Acquisition of property by lease
lead: The authority granted to acquire sites and buildings by purchase or otherwise shall include authority to acquire leaseholds.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1977—Pub. L. 95–105 struck out “of not less than ten years” after “acquire leaseholds”. 1952—Act June 19, 1952, provided for leaseholds of not less than 10 years.
